summary: Retrieve a single webhook for project
description: Fetch a specific webhook by its ID.

id.description: Unique string identifier for this webhook hook. Use as the {id} path parameter in show, update, and delete requests.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the hook. active means event delivery is enabled; disabled means delivery is paused.

namespace.description: Namespace that identifies the integration or application that registered this hook.

Authorization.description: Authorization header value sent with each webhook request, partially redacted for security.

trigger_count.description: Number of triggers associated with this hook

company_id.description: Unique string identifier of the company that owns this hook. Null for project-level hooks.

project_id.description: Unique string identifier of the project this hook is scoped to. Null for company-level hooks.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the webhook was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the webhook was last updated

hook_type.description: Type of hook. "classic" for standard webhook hooks.
